title: Canonical ordinary pullback cohomology coordinates at a stalk
statement: Let A and A' be commutative rings, phi:A to A' a ring map, and M any cochain complex of A-modules. Define the additive equivalence affineTensorPullbackHomologyStalkIso from the localization of H^i(A' tensor_A M) to the stalk of H^i(Q(phi^* tilde M)) by exact tilde homology, canonical tilde stalk localization, the specified tensor-pullback/tilde comparison and the homology factorization. Let e:Q(tilde M) isomorphic to K, let the pullback counit on tilde M be invertible, and suppose L=Lphi^*K has quasi-coherent cohomology. For every prime p of A' and every localized ordinary tensor cohomology class y, the canonical affineDerivedCohomologyStalkIso applied to the localization of affineBaseChangeTildeCohomologyIso(y) equals the stalk cohomology map of the inverse pullback counit followed by Lphi^*(e), applied to affineTensorPullbackHomologyStalkIso(y). No cartesian square or K-flatness of M is assumed.

proof.text:
expand the target coordinate into exact tilde homology, the termwise
pullback comparison, the inverse derived counit and e. The tilde/global-sections
unit followed by the tilde/Gamma counit is the identity by the adjunction triangle.
After taking stalks, naturality of the localization germ map identifies the
localized global-section map with the stalk of this composite. Exact tilde and
homology factorization are the first two factors of
 affineTensorPullbackHomologyStalkIso; the remaining factor is the stalk of the
inverse counit followed by e. Functoriality identifies the composites. This is
valid for all complexes and degrees, including the zero complex and zero rings;
no K-flatness or cartesian base-change square is used.

theorem affineTensorPullbackHomologyStalkIso_coordinates
    (A A' : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing A'] (φg' : A →+* A')
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (.of A)))
    (hL : schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A'))
      ((derivedPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg'))).obj K))
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
        (@id (ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤
          SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
          (tilde.functor (.of A))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj M) ≅ K)
    (hc : IsIso ((SingleComplexBaseChange.counit (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg'))).app
      ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
        (@id (ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤
          SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
          (tilde.functor (.of A))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj M)))) (i : ℤ)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum A') :
    let L : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (Spec (.of A')) := ⟨_, hL⟩
    let b := affineBaseChangeTildeCohomologyIso A A' φg' K M e hc i
    let P := ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      (@id (ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
          (tilde.functor (.of A))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj M)
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A')).toRingedSpace)) i
    let s := RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor (Spec (.of A')).toRingedSpace p
    ∀ y, affineDerivedCohomologyStalkIso A' i p L
        (LocalizedModule.map p.asIdeal.primeCompl b.hom.hom y) =
      s.map (H.map (inv ((SingleComplexBaseChange.counit
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg'))).app
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P)) ≫
            (derivedPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg'))).map e.hom))
        (affineTensorPullbackHomologyStalkIso A A' φg' M p i y)
